gate: Gate 1 (first packaged release of the reference production)
base_commit: 4f9281db51ee8b46056874d634794f7b16b3f5af plus uncommitted export_presets.cfg and main.gd headless-smoke guard

export.note: Binaries live in gitignored Games/emberkeep/dist/ and were copied to a clean Temp dir for launch testing; hashes above identify the tested build.

packaged_launch.method: Copied exe+pck to an empty directory (no project sources present) and ran with the game's own smoke flags.

headless_screenshot_limitation.finding: The first packaged smoke timed out: _shot() awaits RenderingServer.frame_post_draw, which never fires under the dummy renderer, so the 75 s watchdog quit(2).
headless_screenshot_limitation.repair: main.gd _shot() now detects DisplayServer headless, skips capture, records the label in shots_skipped_headless, and continues. Headless smoke verifies gameplay logic; screenshots are a headed concern.
headless_screenshot_limitation.rule: A test harness must never wait unboundedly on a renderer signal that a headless driver cannot produce.

performance_baseline.method: 600 headless frames (logic + physics on CPU, dummy renderer; NOT a GPU rendering benchmark)
performance_baseline.note: Headed GPU frame-rate profiling on the RTX 5070 Ti remains open; headless timing only proves the simulation is cheap.

known_non_blockers: Exit logs show 4 ObjectDB instances leaked and 2 resources still in use on abrupt --quit-after exit; smoke runs that quit through the game path report no errors.
Headed screenshots and headed GPU profiling of the packaged build were not run (would open windows on the operator's desktop); in-editor headed capture evidence already exists under 02-manufacture.
not_yet_established: Human craft review of the packaged build (art/audio quality judgement).
Human rights review of all source lineage (model licenses, font, audio provenance).
Headed packaged-build screenshots and GPU frame-rate profile.
Installer/packaging beyond the raw exe+pck pair.
verdict: PASS for automated packaged acceptance; Gate 1 complete except human craft/rights review and headed GPU profiling.
